description.p: Rocket Relay is a 2D orbital-mechanics puzzle game. Press and drag to pull back the rocket, release to launch, and use gravity from nearby planets to settle the rocket into a stable orbit around the highlighted target. Prior flight paths remain on screen as you retry, fading with age, so you can see how each attempt differs.

Level 3, Gravity Well — threading a multi-body system with a star and two planets
Level 8, Crowded Skies — multiple prior flight paths still visible after retries
